summary: Frontend-only regression + bug fix verification for the location-permission banner on /map (useLocationSharing + map.tsx). Bug is FIXED. Verified 3 scenarios with Playwright driving the browser permission API: (1) With geolocation GRANTED before the map loads (context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation Madrid), /map shows NO 'location-permission-banner' (query returns None); the top bar shows 'Madrid 100%' and Ana's blue dot is placed on Madrid. (2) After ctx.clear_permissions() + reload, banner reappears (as expected) with the 'location-request' 'Permitir' button (state='prompt', not 'blocked' → no 'location-open-settings'). (3) After granting again at the browser level and tapping 'Permitir', the banner is hidden and does NOT come back — confirming the fix that useLocationSharing.request() short-circuits when getForegroundPermissionsAsync().granted is already true, and that the map effect (`if (loc.perm === 'granted') setLocBanner(false)`) closes the banner. Regression clean: map-home renders, groups-bar/group-chip (Grupo 1) visible, fab-recenter, fab-layers→layers-panel, fab-availability→availability-panel, fab-refresh→refresh-panel, fab-sos→sos-panel all work; no red screens; no critical console errors (only harmless 401s during the reload window before the JWT is rehydrated, plus pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents).

'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/map.tsx:213,265,271 (carryover from iteration 13).

action_items: Bug fix verified — no code changes required. Optional: migrate shadow* props to boxShadow and Animated.View pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (cosmetic, carried over).
critical_code_review_comments: useLocationSharing.ts is well-structured: AppState 'active' listener + try/catch on check()/request() correctly recover a stale banner when the user grants permission via the system settings. request() early-return on already-granted avoids the platform prompt loop.

map.tsx line 121: `if (loc.perm === 'granted') setLocBanner(false); else if (sharesLocation) setLocBanner(true);` — correct. The banner render also guards with `loc.perm !== 'granted'` (line 236), so a granted perm can never leave a lingering banner.
map.tsx is now 500 lines — still under the 700-line split threshold but growing; consider extracting Refresh/Availability/Layers panels into /src/components (carryover from iteration 13).

rca_of_issue: Original bug: invited members saw the 'activate device geolocation permission' banner even after granting location; banner didn't dismiss. Root cause was two-fold: (a) useLocationSharing only checked permission on mount, so re-granting via the system settings never updated `perm` from 'denied' → 'granted'; (b) request() blindly called requestForegroundPermissionsAsync() even when the OS already reported 'granted', which on some platforms returns undetermined and left the state stuck. Fix (verified): (1) AppState 'active' listener re-runs check() when the app returns to foreground; (2) request() first calls getForegroundPermissionsAsync() and short-circuits to setPerm('granted') when already granted; (3) map.tsx forces setLocBanner(false) whenever loc.perm === 'granted' and the render itself gates on `loc.perm !== 'granted'`. Playwright reproduction: pre-granting geolocation + loading /map now shows no banner (previously always shown); revoking + reloading correctly re-shows the banner; tapping 'Permitir' hides it and it stays hidden.
